# REI Runner

> Nationwide marketplace connecting real estate investors with local field runners for on-demand property tasks like photos, walkthrough videos, occupancy checks, and drive-bys.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of REI Runner and how the marketplace works.
- [Apply](/apply): Application to become a Founding Runner.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about runners, payouts, and how investors use the platform.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How REI Runner collects, uses, and protects information.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Rules and conditions for using REI Runner.
